card.situation:
VA Sources Sought (RFI) for Memorials Integration Services and Innovation (MISI): Agile software development, DevSecOps, AI/ML, enterprise architecture, and legacy modernization services supporting the VA-EISS platform and Memorial Benefits Services Product Line — forecasted Q1 FY27 procurement.
Reached the owner because NAICS 541512 matches and the firm holds SDVOSB eligibility, but the validated matrix returned a fit score of 0.1875 (3 met, 6 partial, 23 gap out of 33 requirements), and owner rule [ss-types] explicitly excludes RFIs from pursuit.
reasons_for: Owner rule [ss-types] explicitly prohibits responding to RFIs and Sources Sought notices, which are not real solicitations — this notice is an RFI for planning purposes only and no award will result from it [c4480de5-f2074d64-p1-5e2a7274].

The firm has zero Agile software development, DevSecOps, CI/CD, or AI/ML capability, which together constitute the overwhelming majority of the contract scope, leaving 23 of 33 requirements as outright gaps [c4480de5-2d388838-p1-93a42d6e].

With only 22 cleared staff total, the firm cannot field even a single Level 2 System Team (12–17 cross-functional Agile/DevSecOps FTEs) without gutting all other contracts [c4480de5-2d388838-p1-73a28fcd].
reasons_against: The firm's RMF/ATO documentation and NIST-aligned cybersecurity experience (ACAS/Nessus, CMMC Level 2) partially satisfies the security compliance and vulnerability remediation requirements, providing a credible foothold in a narrow slice of the work [c4480de5-2d388838-p1-0cb04dce].
Twenty-two Secret-cleared staff and a documented background-investigation roster process directly meet the personnel security requirements [c4480de5-2d388838-p1-2a58c4ca].

SDVOSB eligibility under NAICS 541512 keeps the firm competitive if a set-aside is applied at the full solicitation stage in Q1 FY27, making an early RFI response a low-cost way to establish visibility [profile: SDVOSB eligibility, NAICS 541512].

drafts.capability_statement:
Sooner Systems LLC — Capability Statement
Response to RFI: Memorials Integration Services and Innovation (MISI) VA-26-00071371

Sooner Systems LLC is a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) headquartered in Norman, OK, operating under NAICS 541512. We provide federal agencies with IT infrastructure support, network administration, cybersecurity staffing, and help desk services, supported by a 24x7 Network Operations Center.

Our cybersecurity practice is grounded in NIST frameworks and Risk Management Framework (RMF) processes, including Assessment and Authorization (A&A) support, ATO documentation, Plan of Action and Milestones (POA&M) management, and vulnerability management using ACAS/Nessus and STIG compliance. We hold a CMMC Level 2 self-assessment and maintain 22 Secret-cleared staff, with demonstrated experience submitting personnel security rosters and managing background investigation requirements on federal contracts.

We acknowledge that the MISI requirement centers on Agile software development, DevSecOps, AI/ML, enterprise architecture, and legacy modernization — capabilities that fall outside our current core competency. We are submitting this response to establish awareness of the procurement, understand the government's teaming and subcontracting expectations, and assess whether a partnership with qualified Agile development firms could position Sooner Systems to contribute meaningfully in cybersecurity, RMF/ATO, and personnel security functions within a larger team.

We welcome the opportunity to discuss the government's vision for this requirement.

Point of Contact: [Owner Name], Sooner Systems LLC | Norman, OK | NAICS 541512 | SDVOSB
questions_for_co: Does the government anticipate any set-aside designation (e.g., SDVOSB, VOSB, or small business) for the full solicitation expected in Q1 FY27, and will teaming arrangements between a prime and subcontractors with complementary capabilities be evaluated favorably? [c4480de5-2d388838-p1-1eb9c977]

What is the minimum team level (Level 1 through 5) the government expects offerors to propose at the Base Period award, and will offerors be permitted to propose a single team at the lowest FTE band (Level 1, 6–11 FTEs) for a specific functional area such as cybersecurity or RMF/ATO support? [c4480de5-2d388838-p1-73a28fcd]

Will the government accept VA-approved toolset alternatives to Jira and GitHub for artifact repository and project tracking, and if so, what is the approval process for proposing substitute tools? [c4480de5-2d388838-p1-1c5d7d52]

Does the government intend to require prior VA-specific experience (e.g., VA-EISS, BIP Platform) as a mandatory qualification, or will demonstrated experience on analogous federal agency platforms be considered acceptable past performance? [c4480de5-2d388838-p1-9964ef6d]

For the AI/ML and LLM documentation requirements, does the government anticipate providing a VA-approved AI framework or toolset that the contractor must operate within, or is the contractor expected to propose its own AI/ML stack subject to VA approval? [c4480de5-2d388838-p1-603543f4]

Will the government consider separating the cybersecurity, RMF/ATO, and vulnerability remediation functions into a discrete task order or Optional Task, allowing specialized small businesses to compete for that scope independently from the Agile development and AI/ML work? [c4480de5-2d388838-p1-65273d8c]

reader.scope_summary: The government is buying Agile software development, DevSecOps, systems operations, architecture, and data analytics services to support the VA's Memorial Benefits Services Product Line and the VA-EISS platform. The Contractor shall provide dedicated cross-functional teams—System Teams and Agile Development Teams—to operate, build, maintain, modernize, and develop the VA-EISS platform and associated benefits systems, including transitioning and decommissioning legacy systems to the BIP Platform. The performance period is one 6-month Base Period with two 12-month Option Periods, plus four Optional Tasks for additional Systems Teams, Agile Development Teams, Training Teams, and Transition Out Support.

The Government will utilize the proposed firm fixed price labor rates which shall be incorporated into the order at time of award as set forth in the Price Schedule.

matrix.quote: Tier 3 tickets must be triaged/acted upon within 24 hours and resolved within a release cycle unless otherwise directed by the PM/COR.
matrix.firm_answer: Sooner Systems LLC provides Tier 1-3 help desk support with 24x7 NOC. Tier 3 triage within 24 hours is within the firm's documented capability. However, 'resolved within a release cycle' implies software release management, which is outside the firm's scope.

matrix.quote: PERFORMANCE DETAILS PERFORMANCE PERIOD The PoP shall be one 6-month Base Period with two 12-month Option Periods, along with four (4) Optional Tasks for additional Systems Teams, Agile Development Teams, Training Teams, and Transition Out Support.
